scoring_justification: Recompute from raw artifacts is infeasible because only aggregated formation energies are available. Scoring uses paper-reported reference values with tolerance and structural ordering check.

outputs.description: Formation energies of tetramer clusters on Pt4/Cu(110) and Au4/Ag(110) surfaces at 0 K, used to verify the stability ranking (linear > square > others).

output_contract.notes: Scoring compares the reported formation energies to the paper's reference values with tolerance and additionally checks that for each system the ordering is 4l > 4S > energies of 4N,4T,4L.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 4, values as reported for Pt4/Cu and Au4/Ag
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's exact reported numbers, used as reference for comparison.

steps.description: Validate file exists and has required shape/columns.
Compare reported formation energies to paper gold values within tolerance.
Check structural ordering: 4l > 4S and 4S > other shapes within slack.
